asset_manifest.pose: An adult female grad student with short black hair and tanned skin, wearing a green sun hat, light green blouse, and khaki safari vest, kneels with excitement on a cream-white limestone shore. She is pointing at a strange, asymmetrical trackway in the damp silt. Nearby, a stylized Pteranodon with a giant colorful head-crest and leather-textured wings is perched on its knuckles, tilting its head curiously at her.

visual_notes.text_style: Bright Teal, high-poly 3D mixed case text with a glossy finish to match the STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3 aesthetic.
visual_notes.ground_texture: Smooth, cream-white fine-grained limestone silt (Plattenkalk) with ripple marks from the SOLNHOFEN formation.
visual_notes.ichnology_spec: The trackway must show quadrupedal Pterosaur marks: Front 'manus' prints are deep, three-fingered asymmetrical 'V' shapes pointing outward. Rear 'pes' prints are slender, elongated, and plantigrade (flat-footed). All tracks are sunken NEGATIVE IMPRESSIONS with soft mud-heave edges.
visual_notes.character_consistency: The paleontologist wears the ID-accurate green sun hat, green skirt, and black hiking boots.
